inspection: AST-only; supplied plugin code was not imported, compiled or executed
limitations: Declared classes are subsets, not Android runtime parity
Dynamic names and members require further runtime/API audit
Application provider supplies only narrow account, visible-context, alert/bulletin, client-call and app-lifecycle subsets

Telegram request/message transport and media are not implemented; only a global activeAccountChanged notification, outgoing text/caption hook, and MESSAGE_CONTEXT_MENU have narrow adapters. Arbitrary hooks, other notification streams and menu types, subclassing and graphics remain unsupported
Required unwired feature families may have partial subsets; consult partially_wired_features, not import success
AST alias inspection is conservative, not a scope-aware Python resolver

General Python import uses AST preflight without executing plugin code; enable repeats inspection and requires explicit trust. Missing APIs, external requirements and unimplemented version policy are blockers. Native adapter IDs remain source-pinned
Six source-pinned native routes exist (Atmospheric Snow plus five); Group Mentions executes its original source through a pinned Python path and remains device-unverified
Premium Dialog Cards 2.1.1 is a separately supplied source pinned by its own SHA-256; it is not part of the Nomadvorga/ayugram-src audit commit used for the other sources
Native routes are host-authored iOS implementations of audited contracts, not translations or execution of Android/plugin code
No native route or bridge route is device-verified, and build success proves compilation only

ios_limitations: Native UIKit/CADisplayLink physics; Android Choreographer and decor overlay are not used
Source counter setting and X-combo label are preserved, including the 1.6 s timeout
The peer avatar is not used as the ball because the native surface opens without a chat target
Tilt uses CoreMotion gravity with the source 0.2 filter, 0.05 dead zone and 1.5 clamp; drag and tap remain available, and motion feel is device-unverified
Original .plugin source is executed by the Python bridge; no Swift reimplementation of the plugin logic
Cooldown feedback uses the adapted BulletinFactory/Toast shim; the ApplicationLoader context is a bounded adapter, not an Android Application
Custom settings/group dialogs use native UIKit text fields and buttons, not pixel-identical Android widgets
Settings sub-pages are reconstructed by the original create_sub_fragment callback
No device, visual or runtime compatibility has been verified

plugins.provenance: User-provided PremiumDialogCards.plugin 2.1.1; exact SHA-256 pinned outside the upstream audit commit
ios_limitations: The chat list draws the card with Core Animation instead of Android Canvas: the source 6 x 5 dp margins, configurable rounding, 90 px blurred avatar bitmap, vertical darken tint, white vertical stroke gradient, muted/online overlays and Saved Messages/service gradients are preserved

The source shrinks the avatar bitmap to 0.75 of the row avatar; iOS keeps the stock avatar layout so the row keeps its existing text/geometry and scroll cost. This is the only intentional visual deviation
Blur uses Core Image on a 90 px copy of the avatar already loaded by the real chat row; results are cached (64 entries) and never computed on the main thread
Cards are dark-theme only, are not drawn in search or the side list, and hide the stock online dot when the source `rcards.online_badge` switch is off
No device run, frame recording or visual/FPS acceptance is claimed
Android pull-up maps to one finger pulling up at the newest message; the gesture only arms when the history is already at the bottom, so normal scrolling and the input panel are never intercepted

Channels that already offer Telegram's stock next-channel pull keep that path; the native route supplies the same stock overscroll control for groups, private chats and bots, so the pull shows the target avatar/title and unread count instead of being invisible
The real chat list applies the source target kinds, first/most/least-unread strategy, muted, pinned, other-folder and manual-unread filters
Selection uses one Postbox transaction over root and archive, so it does not depend on a lazy chat list signal; forum topics keep stock Telegram behaviour
Folders outside the current one are only scanned when the source other-folders switch is on
The control is Telegram iOS's own overscroll pill, not a pixel copy of the Android ChatPullingDownDrawable; the release threshold and animation are the host's
GAME_HTML is extracted at runtime from the SHA-256-verified plugin source and rendered in WKWebView; no game logic is reimplemented
Android parity: base URL https://localhost/, __GW__ replaced by 150, __SP__ replaced by 1, window.__ev polled every 0.3 s, sand://close dismisses
localStorage keeps sand_rows and sand_v1 exactly as the source expects, so the in-page settings and save/load behave like Android
The plugin's Python launcher still imports threading and is blocked on the bridge path; this native route is host-owned
Rendering, touch feel and FPS on a device are unverified; CI only compiles the route
iOS has no FLAG_SECURE equivalent and cannot delete or sanitize an already saved screenshot
A window-level shield hides the whole screen before capture instead of masking individual names/avatars
Automatic mode reacts to UIScreen capture; manual mode is an explicit in-app toggle
